rv.q: Mr. Groban has not yet reached deeply enough into the tortured soul of the character
Sweeney Todd is here to enrich your nightmares.
Groban is better able than some to explore the other edges of the barber's frayed psyche.
Groban has a nice-guy persona and lacks the sinister side to convince as a man 'even rats fear.'
These choices don't stop the show from working but do defang what should be a blood-curdling night of theatre.
Add a final tableau that will steal your breath faster than a shave in Sweeney Todd's barber chair, and Sondheim, even from beyond the grave, has achieved his goal.
